description: Configuration for navigation test case generation

dataset.description: Dataset to use for test case generation (filtered by selected=true + functional_mappings)

generation.description: Test case generation settings - generates both preconditions (depth 1-7) and functional (depth 8+)

categories.name: preconditions/app_entry
categories.description: Application entry points (sign in, join meeting, sign up)

functional_categories.description: Manual mapping of control names to functional test directories (depth 8+) - MUST use exact names from dataset

test_case_template.description: Template settings for generated YAML files

notes: custom_dataset_reference: Points to the dataset JSON file to be referenced in generated YAML files
- Use 'datasets/core/data/go_to_core_controls_raw' for original dataset without overrides
- Use 'datasets/core/data/go_to_core_controls' for dataset with core_controls_overrides.json applied
slice_points: Depths where child test cases reference parent test cases
- E.g., [4] means depth 5-7 reference depth 4
max_depth: Maximum depth for test case generation (7 = preconditions only)
- Depth 1-3: app_entry (sign in, join meeting)
- Depth 4-7: app_core (pre-meeting setup)
- Depth 8+: in_meeting operations (now manual in navigations/functional/in_meeting/)
pre_conditions_path_prefix: Path prefix for pre_conditions references in YAML files
check_points: List of test validation checkpoints to include in all generated test cases
- E.g., ['Keyboard Navigation'] ensures all tests validate keyboard accessibility
optional_steps: List of step names that should be marked as optional in generated test cases
- Used for UI path steps that may not appear (e.g., 'Accept' dialogs, dismissible notifications)
- Applies to steps within UI paths, not just final control names
- Note: For independent controls, use self_calibration.json with 'optional: true' instead
categorization: Organize generated test cases into subdirectories by depth
- enabled: true/false to enable/disable categorization
- base_path: Base path for categorized test cases
- categories: List of category definitions with name, depth_range, and description
- depth_range: [min, max] inclusive range for category
- category_overrides: Manual mapping of control names to categories (overrides depth-based rules)
- Example: 'Sign in to app': 'app_entry' forces this control to app_entry regardless of depth
- Generated structure: navigations/preconditions/app_entry/ (4 files), .../app_core/ (24 files)
- In-meeting tests (depth 8+): Manually created in navigations/functional/in_meeting/ (28 files)
* audio/ (3 files): Audio settings, mute controls, audio switching
* video/ (4 files): Video settings, virtual background, self-view, video systems
* chat/ (2 files): Chat panel, messaging
* share/ (3 files): Screen sharing, sharing settings, content types
* participants/ (3 files): Participant panel, invitations, raise hand
* panels/ (4 files): Apps panel, AI Assistant, whiteboards, more panels
* meeting_controls/ (6 files): Recording, reactions, breakout sessions, meeting options
* accessibility/ (3 files): Closed captions, sign language interpretation
